findings.title: Multiple dependent claims refer to antecedents conjunctively ("and") instead of in the alternative
findings.attack: 37 CFR 1.75(c)/MPEP 608.01(n) require alternative-only reference in multiple dependent claims; "any one of claims 1 and 5 to 12" states the reference conjunctively across roughly a third of the claim set.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Replace "and" with a comma throughout (full per-claim list in the Prompt 37 forensic-audit reply).

findings.title: Brief description of the drawings omits FIG. 13A, registered in the numeral registry as numeral 220
findings.attack: 37 CFR 1.74/MPEP 608.01(f) require every figure to be described; FIG. 13A and numeral 220 are registered but never described in the Brief Description or Detailed Description.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add Brief Description and Detailed Description text for FIG. 13A/220, or remove FIG. 13A and numeral 220 from the figure plan and registry.

corrections.from_text: of any one of claims 1 and 5 to 12
corrections.to: of any one of claims 1, 5 to 12
Add Brief Description and Detailed Description text for FIG. 13A/220, or remove FIG. 13A and numeral 220 from the figure plan and registry

assumptions.text: Default jurisdictions are US, EPO and UK per the matter's standing instructions.
Absence of an abstract and of rendered drawing sheets is expected at this stage and recorded as not applicable / open rather than fail.

EPO two-part claim form is treated as commonly deferred to examination (Rule 43(3) EPC); assigning a characterising portion now would pre-empt the substantive closest-prior-art selection of Prompt 30/32.

open_questions.text: Whether FIG. 13A is to be retained in the drawings package gates the correction in F-40a-2.
Scheduling of the abstract and drawing sheets is for the Orchestrator, not this audit.
